title: Finite generation via a finite spanning set
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $B=\bigoplus_{k\ge0}B_k$ a commutative graded $A$-algebra (the $B_k$ are $A$-submodules with $B_kB_l\subseteq B_{k+l}$ and $1\in B_0$, the structure map $A\to B$ landing in $B_0$) which is a finite type $A$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and write $f^\sharp(a)\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ for the image of $a\in A$. Let $(\mathcal G_m)_{m\ge0}$ be quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent], and for all $k,m\ge0$ and $b\in B_k$ let $\mu^{(m)}_b:\mathcal G_m\to\mathcal G_{m+k}$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-linear map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], such that: (i) $\mu^{(m)}_{b+b'}=\mu^{(m)}_b+\mu^{(m)}_{b'}$ for $b,b'\in B_k$; (ii) $\mu^{(m+l)}_b\circ\mu^{(m)}_{b'}=\mu^{(m)}_{bb'}$ for $b\in B_k$, $b'\in B_l$; (iii) for $a\in A$ with image $a\cdot1\in B_0$, $\mu^{(m)}_{a\cdot1}$ is multiplication by $f^\sharp(a)$ on $\mathcal G_m$; (iv) (finite type) $X$ is covered by open sets $U$ for each of which there are finitely many integers $d_1,\dots,d_r\ge0$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal G_{d_i}(U)$ such that for every $m\ge0$, every open $V\subseteq U$ and every $t\in\mathcal G_m(V)$, each point of $V$ has an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq V$ on which $t|_W=\sum_{i:\,d_i\le m}\sum_jc_{ij}\,\mu^{(d_i)}_{b_{ij}}(s_i)|_W$ for finitely many $c_{ij}\in\mathcal O_X(W)$ and $b_{ij}\in B_{m-d_i}$. (These data are the same as a quasi-coherent graded module $\bigoplus_m\mathcal G_m$ of finite type over the graded $\mathcal O_X$-algebra $f^*\widetilde B$, $b\in B_k$ acting through its pulled-back global section.) Fix p >= 0 and put M_m=H^p(X,G_m) [pqf-def-cohomology]. Let mod be any B-module structure on the additive direct sum M of the M_m, such that for every b in B_k and x in M_m, b acting on the degree-m inclusion of x is the degree-(m+k) inclusion of H^p(mu_m(b))(x). Then the top submodule of M, viewed as a B-submodule of the direct sum, is finitely generated over B. The compatibility hypothesis is imposed on this very mod, not on a different existentially quantified action.

proof.text: Construct the relative-spectrum module from the compatible graded action. Proper base change gives a proper scheme over Spec B; finite type over the noetherian base makes the pulled-back module coherent. Proper coherent cohomology is a finite B-module. The affine cohomology edge map and the quasi-compact quasi-separated direct-sum comparison identify this finite module with the stated direct sum and preserve the homogeneous action. Hence the supplied compatible action has a finite spanning set, equivalently its top B-submodule is FG.
